text:
mike_sales: Quick check: Deal with FinLead — want to finalize POC hosting. They need EU data residency, 4-week POC, success criteria, and a security questionnaire deadline next Wed. Thoughts on hosted vs dedicated vs private?

samir_se: Short summary: Use cases: sensitive document summarization + Q&A. Prompts: 15 canonical prompts + 200 user prompt eval set. Success criteria: p95 latency <200ms, availability 99.5%, semantic R@1 >= 0.78 on eval. Throughput target 50 req/s. Timeline 4 wks: deploy, ingest, run evals, iterate.

nina_infosec: EU residency implies Dedicated or Private w/ EU region. Hosted with data residency? We have hosted EU region but they require dedicated tenancy + KMS. Need SSO, audit logs. Also SOC2 items on questionnaire.

raj_sre: Dedicated in eu-central-1 will give predictable p95 and throughput. Estimate: 2x A10 GPUs reserved with autoscale + burst. Cost estimate ~ $8k/day for POC peak. If cost is an issue, can do hosted with VPC peering & customer-managed KMS as a compromise. ping @samir_se for fallback model.

samir_se: We can run initial eval on hosted eu-west-1 to get baseline (1 week), then flip to Dedicated for performance run. Success criteria gating: baseline >=0.6 on R@1 to proceed to Dedicated. That reduces up-front cost.

olivia_pm: Customer timeline: wants embed + response time demo in week 2. Can we commit to hosted baseline + dedicated roll next week 3? Also need security questionnaire answers by Wed.

mike_sales: What's needed from customer to spin up Dedicated? region, ingress IP allowlist, KMS ARN, expected QPS, sample data? I can collect.

raj_sre: Yes: region, CIDR, KMS, SAML metadata for SSO (optional), data classification. Also private option requires on-prem contact + install window (~2 weeks more).

nina_infosec: I'll take questionnaire. Send it to me and legal. Quick checklist: data retention policy, encryption at rest in KMS, key rotation, access review cadence, incident notification SLAs, penetration test results.

samir_se: Attach eval snippet and curl for hosted baseline:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b", "prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":256}'
```
Use concurrency 10 and 10K token window.

mike_sales: I'll loop customer in. @olivia_pm can you draft runbook with milestones (week0 kickoff, week1 baseline, week2 ingest/iterate, week3 dedicated perf, week4 handoff)?

olivia_pm: On it. Also adding eval pass/fail: latency p95 <200ms; R@1 >=0.78; 75% success on safety filters.

mike_sales: Nice. Also pricing question: raj, can you give hosted baseline cost estimate for 1 week vs dedicated 2-week run?

raj_sre: Hosted baseline ~ $1.2k for 1 week (small instance pool). Dedicated 2-week perf run w/ reserved capacity ~ $90k (including engineering ops). Will formalize in pricing doc.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: hosted-baseline-euw at 2026-04-01T08:00Z by infra-team

nina_infosec: :thumbsup: Send questionnaire asap. I'll prioritize.
